entities.summary: Mirali Miralakbar oghlu Seyidov was an Azerbaijani mythologist, turkologist, literary scholar, member of the Union of Azerbaijani Writers (1976), doctor of philological sciences (1968), professor (1979), and corresponding member of the Azerbaijan National Academy of Creativity.
